Platform Engineering Adoption: What the Evidence Says

Internal developer platforms are pitched as a cure for cognitive load. The evidence is thinner than the pitch, and it splits by organisation size.

Where the claim comes from

The 2024 DORA report found that platform teams correlate with throughput gains only above roughly 1,500 engineers. Below that threshold the effect is not distinguishable from noise.

A second reading, from the Thoughtworks Radar, places platform-as-a-product in adopt but qualifies it with a team-size caveat.

The caveat everyone drops

The throughput figure is measured against teams that had no golden path at all. It is not a comparison against a well-run monorepo.

What to watch

  • Platform team headcount as a share of engineering
  • Time-to-first-deploy for a new service
    • Measured from repository creation
    • Excluding approval queues
  • Voluntary adoption rate — the only honest signal
  1. Measure the baseline before building anything.
  2. Ship one golden path.
  3. Refuse to mandate it for six months.
